title: In Q3 2026, 12 lawyers were in good standing to practice law in cities within Douglas County
text:
Business
In Q3 2026, 12 lawyers were in good standing to practice law in cities within Douglas County
There were 12 lawyers in good standing in cities within Douglas County as of the third quarter of 2026.
Douglas County had 12 lawyers in good standing practicing only city as of the third quarter of 2026, according to the Missouri Bar.
Compared to the same period from the previous year, the lawyer population increased from the nine reported in the county at the time.
In the bigger picture, Missouri recorded a total of 14,111 lawyers in good standing in the third quarter of 2026.
Data refers to all lawyers who were actively practicing during this time period. Lawyers in good standing do not have any complaints or disciplinary actions being taken against them.
As of July 1, 2026, average lawyer salaries in Missouri ranged from $95,058 for an entry-level attorney handling routine legal work (Attorney I) to $240,889 for highly experienced attorneys managing complex cases with significant autonomy (Attorney V). Mid-level attorneys, such as those in Attorney III roles—who handle highly complex legal work with moderate supervision—earned on average $178,272 in Missouri, compared to $187,635 nationwide.
Missouri has a high concentration of lawyers, with nearly four attorneys per 1,000 residents in 2024 — the 10th highest ratio in the country, according to the ABA Profile of the Legal Profession.
The United States has more than 1.3 million active lawyers, with employment projected to grow 4% between 2024 and 2034, according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
